Titles.eng: Haikyuu!! Movie 2: The Winner and the Loser
Titles.jpn: 劇場版ハイキュー!! 勝者と敗者

Summaries.eng: The members of the Karasuno volleyball team, including Hinata and Kageyama, push themselves to the limit to win the Inter-High Preliminaries. Their team has great individual players. Their task now is to learn to work together as one -- and win.
